turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.
I can look into this for you. Please send the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with, so I can find your damage claim.
This is about the existing claim for SC-2308. I ordered with ada.blymere@example.com.

Thank you, Ada. I've passed your dispute of the SC-2308 claim to a colleague, who will take over from here. They will review the decision that the scrape is part of the artwork, using the details you've described: a raised scratch across the ink.
